title: Decoding an encoded quantified formula
statement: For every finite Boolean word $q$ and every CNF formula $\varphi$ over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$, decoding the pair encoding of $q$ and the binary serialization of $\varphi$ gives the quantified Boolean formula with quantifier prefix obtained by interpreting each true bit as existential and each false bit as universal, and matrix $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula over variables indexed by ℕ
